details.label: Discussion
details.text: A compact cluster of strong/severe storms continues over portions central NE at 0615z, with a recent report of a measured 79 mph gust at Grand Island, NE. This cluster continues to move southeast at 50 mph, and a severe wind risk will likely continue through 07-08z given a favorable near-term downstream environment. Thus a local extension in time and/or area may be needed to cover this threat. As low-level warm advection strengthens farther west, new thunderstorm development is anticipated over central/south-central NE within a steep mid-level lapse rate environment and modestly strong mid-level flow. A localized wind and hail threat is expected with this new development into the early morning hours, however the overall coverage is expected to remain such that a new watch is not currently expected
